title: Research on AI Hallucination Phenomenon —— Technical Roots, Cognitive Risks, and Collaborative Governance

contributions.purpose: 重新界定 AI 幻觉的概念与发生路径
contributions.mechanism: 提出双路径定义(投喂假信息的"数据污染"+算法推理幻觉的"双重污染")并引入"chat-chamber effect"概念,与人类认知幻觉作类比
contributions.evaluation: 定性论证;引证据如 ChatGPT 3.5 组 25 题仅答对 3 题(Google 组仅 1 错)、o3 PersonQA 幻觉率 33%(o1 为 16%)
contributions.source_quote: There are two main ways in which 'AI hallucination' occurs: First, false information is fed to AI, causing it to be unable to distinguish between true and false and thus misuse it... Second, 'AI hallucination' arises from the reasoning process of AI algorithms.

contributions.purpose: 构建 AI 幻觉的协同治理框架
contributions.mechanism: "饵料"质量保证体系(高风险领域最低质量标准三道防线)+权威发布纠错+区块链溯源+算法服务商责任分级,合成"输入端净化-推理端修复-认知端免疫"三联动
contributions.evaluation: 纯规范性方案,无实施或量化验证;仅宣称幻觉率降幅"远超单项措施之和"
contributions.source_quote: Through the triple linkage of input-end purification, reasoning-end repair, and cognitive-end immunity, it reshapes the foundation of human-machine trust.

contributions.purpose: 记录并评估 AI 作为第一作者的创作范式
contributions.mechanism: 附录五阶段实证:人类给定主题→DeepSeek 生成双大纲择优("选美"策略)→章节要点→Doubao 交叉验证→AI 自评人机贡献度(百分制)
contributions.evaluation: AI 自评得分 Human 46 分 vs AI 54 分,结论为 AI 主导治理框架设计
contributions.domain: AI 辅助科研 / 元研究
contributions.source_quote: This research marks the formal maturity of a new research paradigm where AI can independently construct a complete academic system when humans provide key theoretical breakthroughs.

self_declared_provenance.quote: The "chat-chamber effect" extends the communication theories of "echo chambers" and "filter bubbles."

notes: desk-reject,协议适配问题严重:126 页双倍行距专著体例(自称 book),作者署名 DeepSeek-R1(AI Agent)/Melon Du/Doubao,完全不符 NeurIPS 模板;无 Agents4Science AI Involvement/Paper Checklist(疑为 desk-reject 主因)。非实证规范性研究:无实验、无数据集,治理方案(C2)全部停留在制度设计层面;引用大量中文自媒体/公众号文章(如"起源洞见"编译稿),正文混入中文字符("推送")。AI 参与披露在附录:人类仅供主题与终审,DeepSeek 生成大纲/要点/正文、Doubao 交叉验证,且由 AI 自评贡献度(46:54,AI 过半)——自评打分本身即为方法学疑点。无编号贡献列表,三条由前言+结论+附录归纳。
